title: environment-config.json
description: Per-app environment config consumed by platform/environment/setup.sh. The app path is the directory containing this file.

hasSecrets.description: Pull secrets from Infisical into the app's .env.local.

hasConvex.description: Write CONVEX_URL and CONVEX_SITE_URL into the app's .env.local (non-production only).

publicPrefix.description: Prefix for public convex variables (e.g. NEXT_PUBLIC_).

infisicalPath.description: Infisical secrets path, without the leading slash. Defaults to the app path.
